greeting: Well hello there, fellow pixel-pushers and code connoisseurs!
introParagraph: This week's Release Radar is buzzing with a blend of AI-infused innovations and crucial stability enhancements. While some plugins are getting smarter with artificial intelligence, others are ensuring your sites stay secure and performant. It seems the WordPress ecosystem is both evolving and solidifying its foundations, which is always a good sign for us all.

highlights.title: MonsterInsights 11.1.0
highlights.summary: MonsterInsights just dropped a shiny new AI-Powered Headline Analyser! This sounds like a fantastic tool to help boost your content's click-through rates, making your analytics even more actionable beyond just numbers.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Instagram Feed 6.11.4
highlights.summary: Big news for Instagram Feed Free users! You can now filter by Photos, Videos, and Reels, giving your users more control over their feed experience. Plus, they've ensured your Instagram images will finally honor their intended quality.

highlights.title: SeedProd 6.20.7
highlights.summary: SeedProd is jumping on the AI train, integrating a 'Manage with AI' page and recommending WPVibe for AI assistance. While technically a fix in this iteration, the underlying feature push towards AI site management is definitely noteworthy and worth keeping an eye on.

highlights.title: WPCode 2.3.8
highlights.summary: For those of us constantly tweaking CSS, WPCode now lets you resize and remember the size of the code editor on the Live CSS Preview screen. A small tweak, perhaps, but a mighty one for workflow efficiency and developer happiness!

closingJoke: Why did the WordPress developer break up with the JavaScript framework? Because he needed more commitment, and it just kept reacting! Don't worry, your plugins are more stable than my love life.
